dbsep.title: Clinic databases
dbsep.lead: Each clinic (or medical centre with all its practices) in a fully separate database: its patients, visits, money and files. Accounts, the list of clinics and subscriptions stay in the main database.
dbsep.in_main: Clinics still in the main database

on.cpanel: Every new clinic gets its database automatically through cPanel.
on.mysql: Every new clinic gets its database automatically on the MySQL server.

dbsep.off: Every clinic is in the main database for now. Turn it on in the settings file (.env), then restart the app.
dbsep.how: On cPanel hosting add these lines to the .env file in the app folder, then restart the app from Setup Node.js App:
dbsep.how_token: The token is made in cPanel → Security → Manage API Tokens. It is never shown in the app nor sent anywhere. Database names start with the cPanel user name.
dbsep.how_mysql: On your own server (VPS): TENANT_DB_DRIVER=mysql, if the database user may create databases.
dbsep.safety: A move happens in one go: everything moves or nothing does. While a clinic moves, its users see "moving, try again in a minute" for a few seconds. Take a backup before moving them all.
dbsep.move_title: Move clinics to their own databases
dbsep.move_sub: New clinics are created in their own database. Older ones are moved from here — a medical centre moves with all its practices into one database.
dbsep.move_all_confirm: {n} (clinics or centres) will move to separate databases, one after another. Make sure you have a backup. Continue?
dbsep.waiting_sub: Move one first to try it before moving all.
dbsep.move_one_confirm: This clinic (or the centre with all its practices) moves to a database of its own. Continue?
dbsep.stopping: Moving stops after the current clinic.

not_started.off: Separate databases are off in the settings.
